class.name: haptiquad_nav/HaptiQuadNavPlanner
class.description: Holonomic lookahead local planner for the HaptiQuad tactile-navigation system. Strafes the robot directly toward a lookahead point on the global plan while applying a concurrent yaw P-controller toward the final goal heading. Subscribes to /haptiquad_nav/speed_limit for contact-probe speed capping.
